research_entity_identity: Clay temporary worker; not self.root; not Frank
hypothesis_under_test: A nonce-bound one-shot task-switch challenge is sufficient to prove current-user consent for replacing an unfinished task.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Nonce possession plus a caller-supplied stable TaskSnapshot is not current-user consent authority. If the same proposer receives the nonce and may call grant(), it can self-grant without any new authenticated user confirmation event.

source_observation.claim_scope: Current parent code path and adversarial test design; target-VPS execution receipt still pending/unknown.

owner_contract_relation.owner_fixed_requirement: unfinished current user task may not be silently abandoned; unrelated task switch requires current-user consent
owner_contract_relation.gap: The candidate proves challenge freshness/replay binding but does not itself prove that a distinct current-user confirmation occurred.

exactly_one_go_out_of_box_experiment.name: CONSENT_NONCE_ECHO_SELF_GRANT
sequence: echo returned nonce into grant() with same snapshot

external_primary_mechanism_evidence.relevance: MRTR represents user confirmation/input as an input_required response followed by a client-supplied answer on retry, separating request-for-input from receipt-of-input. Mechanism evidence only.
User confirmation is returned as client input and then processed on re-entry; mechanism evidence only, not Frank authority.

required_architecture_delta_candidate.name: AUTHENTICATED_CURRENT_USER_CONFIRMATION_RECEIPT
invariants: proposer/model cannot synthesize the confirmation receipt
nonce possession alone is not consent authority
confirmation receipt cannot mint execution/effect authority
required_architecture_delta_candidate.rollback: Keep #370 as candidate-only replay/snapshot mechanism; do not promote its consent-authority claim until the independent confirmation producer is composed and falsified.
